title: "Manuscript: MPX NYC Intervention Strategy"

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
#| label: fig-radarage
#| fig-cap: "fig-radarage"
#| 




  targets::tar_read(participant_data) %>%
    group_by(age) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(age)) %>%
    mutate(level = age) %>%
    mutate(proportion = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot() + 
          ggplot2::geom_bar(aes(x = level, fill = level, y = proportion), width = 1, stat = "identity") + 
          ggplot2::theme_void() + 
          ggplot2::theme(
                          legend.position = "none", 
                          panel.grid.major.y = ggplot2::element_line(size = 0.1),
                          axis.text.x = element_text(),
                          axis.text.y = element_text()
                          ) + 
          ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(
                                                dark_blue, 
                                                dark_pink, 
                                                dark_purple, 
                                                light_blue, 
                                                light_pink, 
                                                light_purple)
            ) + 
      ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, "cm"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      ) + 
    labs(
      title    = captions_and_titles("radarage")$title,
      subtitle = captions_and_titles("radarage")$subtitle,
      caption  = captions_and_titles("radarage")$caption
    )
```
